content: Art 7 Directive 2023/970: workers may request in writing their individual pay level and average pay levels broken down by sex for their category; may request via workers representatives or an equality body; may demand substantiated clarification if the reply is inaccurate or incomplete; employers must inform workers annually of the right (7(3)); reply due within a reasonable period and in any event within two months (7(4)); pay-secrecy clauses prohibited (7(5)); employers MAY require the worker not to use information other than own pay for any purpose other than exercising the equal pay right (7(6)). NOTHING in Art 7 limits how often a worker may request. Criteria for pay, pay levels and pay progression are Article 6, not Article 7. Art 12(3) lets Member States route information only to workers reps, labour inspectorate or equality body where an individual would be identifiable. Art 25 is Victimisation and protection against less favourable treatment.
